note: *falaram mentiras* held against the gate Latinist's *falsidades*: ψεύδη is also *mendácium*'s Greek (D15's test), *falsidades* jingles at the close, and the first gate passed *mentiras*.
*caiu fogo sobre eles* was made on the first Latinist's remark; the gate asked to go back to *de cima*. The Latinist contradicts himself between runs (cf. D24); *de cima* is option 2.

*Antes que os vossos espinhos entendessem o espinheiro*: the blind reader found it incomprehensible and did not know *espinheiro*. Kept as the Latin and Greek say it; *sarça* is the option, but it is the Burning Bush.
